item.title: MTH2001 Algebraic Structures Practical 2
item.description: Practical Sheet. Question 1 Using the Definition of a Field, we can check if the following are fields… M=\left\{ \frac{a}{b}:a,b\in \mathbb{Z},a \text{ is odd} \right\} - not a field as it’s not closed under addition; let a_{1}=2m+1,a_{2}=2n+1 such that \frac{a_{1}}{b} + \frac{a_{2}}{b} = \frac{a_{1}+a_{2}}{b}= \frac{2m+1+2n+1}{a} = 2(m+n+1), which is an even number.
